replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. I sometimes feel challenged by complex problems, but I don't get anxious. Instead, I see them as opportunities to learn and improve my skills.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI tutor for a few months. It helped me understand concepts better by providing step-by-step explanations. The experience was positive, but I still prefer human interaction for deeper understanding.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA is used to reduce data dimensions. First, standardize the data. Then, compute the covariance matrix and find its eigenvalues and eigenvectors. Sort eigenvectors by eigenvalues in descending order. Project data onto the top eigenvectors. The math can be complex, but it's manageable with practice.
